source-integrity.provenance: FY2026 10-K and results plus acquisition/dividend releases are primary; Sep.25 market data is independent
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: market valuation source is independent; issuer releases are not double-counted as independent corroboration

thesisQuality.basis: Record FY26 sales, organic growth, margin expansion and broad motion/control critical applications demonstrate durable demand and value capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: FY26 sales rose 8.3% to $21.5B, organic sales 6.6%, adjusted net income rose 16%, and Q4 adjusted segment margin reached 28.0%.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep.25 price $978.33 implies ~34.35x trailing and ~27.55x forward earnings, demanding relative to strong but not riskless growth.

catalystScore.basis: Filtration Group integration and FY31 adjusted segment margin target of 30% are material identifiable catalysts, though synergy realization remains prospective.

governancePower.basis: 70 consecutive fiscal years of dividend increases, active capital deployment and repeated margin/portfolio execution support strong stewardship evidence.

alignment2036.basis: Motion/control, aerospace and filtration technologies serve durable industrial, transport, energy and critical-system reliability needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core engineering capabilities span diversified industrial and aerospace markets with aftermarket and filtration reuse across many applications.

bottleneckControl.basis: Qualified motion/control and filtration components in critical applications create switching/qualification friction and aftermarket attachment.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Broad industrial, aerospace, transportation, energy and aftermarket exposure provides multiple independent demand engines.

substitutionResilience.basis: Critical engineered components, application qualification and installed-base aftermarket create meaningful replacement barriers.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Global diversified portfolio and manufacturing footprint support resilience, while acquisition integration and industrial supply dependencies prevent an exceptional score.

pricingPower.basis: Sustained adjusted segment margin expansion to 28.0% alongside organic growth supports strong value capture and pricing/mix discipline.

riskEvidence.basis: Primary risks are Filtration Group integration, portfolio complexity, cyclical industrial demand and a rich valuation that reduces downside headroom.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Audited 10-K, current results, completed acquisition evidence and current independent market valuation cover the principal underwriting dimensions; synergy outcomes remain prospective.

scoreRecord.thesis: Parker compounds a broad installed base of mission-critical motion/control technologies through margin discipline, aftermarket economics and portfolio expansion, with diversification across industrial and aerospace end markets.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: High valuation and acquisition integration can compress returns if margin expansion or synergy realization falls short.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Filtration Group integration milestones and FY27 results against the raised long-term margin framework.
